navSidebar.title: Your main menu
navSidebar.body: Every page for managing your team lives here: calendar, budget, R&D, performance, stock and strategy.

dashboardStats.title: Overview
dashboardStats.body: The number of races this season and the percentage of your budget already spent, at a glance.

dashboardDeficits.title: Car weak points
dashboardDeficits.body: The three biggest performance gaps versus the competition, worth fixing first.

dashboardStock.title: Stock status
dashboardStock.body: A summary of your parts stock health: what's fine, what's low, and what's critical.

calendarList.title: Season calendar
calendarList.body: The full list of races for the season. You can reorder it by dragging.

calendarRaceCard.title: Race details
calendarRaceCard.body: Check off a race once it's done, and spot its type (Fast, Balanced, Downforce, Test) via the colored badge.

budgetStats.title: Budget tracking
budgetStats.body: Your budget cap, the amount spent, and what's left. Click the cap to edit it.

budgetCapUsage.title: Budget usage
budgetCapUsage.body: A visual gauge of how much of your cap has been used.

budgetAllocation.title: Breakdown by section
budgetAllocation.body: The detail of spending and allocation per budget section, editable and expandable.

rdCreateProject.title: Start an R&D project
rdCreateProject.body: Pick a car part to start a new development project.

rdActiveProjects.title: Active projects
rdActiveProjects.body: Track the progress, cost and expected gains of each of your active R&D projects.

rdAeroTable.title: Aerodynamic table
rdAeroTable.body: Detailed per-part stats: base value, gains, target and remaining gap.

performanceAtrTable.title: ATR calibration table
performanceAtrTable.body: Compare your car's stats to the competition, section by section.

performanceImportScreenshot.title: Import from a screenshot
performanceImportScreenshot.body: Paste a screenshot of your ATR data: the AI extracts it and pre-fills the table for you.

performanceDevPlan.title: Development plan
performanceDevPlan.body: The list of your ongoing development projects and their expected impact on the ATR.

stockCoverageChart.title: Stock coverage
stockCoverageChart.body: Visually compare your available stock to what the season requires.

stockPiecesGrid.title: Per-part detail
stockPiecesGrid.body: Adjust the stock count, lifespan and unit cost for each part.

strategyParams.title: Race parameters
strategyParams.body: Set the lap count, pit stop loss, and the degradation data for each tire compound.

strategyRanking.title: Strategy ranking
strategyRanking.body: Every viable tire strategy, ranked by estimated total time.

strategyOptimal.title: Optimal strategy
strategyOptimal.body: The best computed strategy for this race, with its pit stop breakdown.

settingsTabs.title: Settings
settingsTabs.body: Customize the appearance, your profile, your data, navigation and the app's language.

settingsSaves.title: Saves
settingsSaves.body: Create, rename, export or import multiple save slots for your game.
